definitions.collision_correction: Frozen engine collisions aggregate original_unit_energy captured after movement and BEFORE SAP. Same-step sap cost/damage does not change collision energy comparison.
definitions.entering: Visible eligible neighbor actually issues cardinal move whose destination is the defender tile; counts proposal, not post-collision visibility.
definitions.funnel: all known live singletons -> after_rule STAY -> inferred_pt_sap, legal SAP, final and recorded SAP, first_on_tile UID -> visible adjacent entrant possible -> exactly one possible entrant and SAP center equals its current position and stay margin>0,sap margin<=0. Margins are cost-only descriptors.
definitions.known_singleton: Non-match-start, masked own slot with energy>=0 on known point and own_stack_size==1; additionally exact all-masked single occupancy is required for strict funnel.
definitions.match_timing: First scoring transition indexed by match_step_t+1; last onset of uninterrupted strictly negative points_after through match end = descriptive permanent deficit onset, not irrecoverability.
definitions.outcome: For non-reset transitions only, own observed mask/energy/position; productive tile from external truth after. No lifetime/death attribution.
definitions.sampling: Outcome-stratified 20 games /10 maps, not prevalence or strength sample. No unit-step CIs.
definitions.snapshots: State t at match_step_t=25/50/75/100; known updated by act(obs_t). Intersection with true active tiles used. Equal weighting within game then games.
